Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `DefaultParserTest.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/local_workplace/commons-cli/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/cli/DefaultParserTest.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

I'll start by reading the original test file and the CUT to understand what needs to be improved.Now I have a good picture of the code. Let me write the improved test with better understandability — clearer comments, descriptive assertion messages, constants for repeated literals, and a helper method to reduce option-creation boilerplate.Now let me run the compile check.The improved test compiled successfully. The refactored `DefaultParserTest.java` adds named constants (`BARE_VALUE`, `QUOTED_VALUE`) to eliminate repeated string literals, introduces a `buildLetterOption` helper to reduce option-creation boilerplate across five tests, adds descriptive assertion failure messages throughout, fixes the misleading `// Trigger handler:` comment in `testDeprecated`, and adds Javadoc-style comments on each test to explain the behavior under test and the distinction between `IGNORE`/`SKIP`/`THROW` actions.
